audit_findings.title: The 2018 owner-earnings datum is almost certainly a unit or parsing error
audit_findings.magnitude: Loaded datum is $26,470.3 million, 35.2x 2025 revenue; if the intended value is $26.4703 million, the overstatement is $26,443.8297 million and the computed capped anchor rises from $82.2 million to $100.1 million (+21.8%)
audit_findings.mechanism: The erroneous historical observation distorts the log-trend used to set anchor OE and therefore every scenario's operating value
audit_findings.evidence: For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, we generated revenues of $751.5 million, $637.8 million, and $536.9 million, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: The scale contradiction demonstrates that the loaded datum is erroneous, although the exact intended 2018 amount remains unverified. Because the outlier occurs early in the regression, it flattens the fitted trend and understates rather than overstates the selected anchor. A conditional correction to $26.4703 million produces a trend near $105.7 million, so the latest-OE cap would set the anchor at $100.1 million; holding other inputs fixed, base value would rise from $33.51 to approximately $39.85 per share.
audit_findings.action: Recover the 2018 OE components from the original filing, correct the unit or parsing fault, and rerun the anchor, RONTA, too-hard rationale, all scenarios, and buy-below price.

audit_findings.title: Acquired-intangible amortization may have been added back without an economic replacement charge
audit_findings.magnitude: $37.169 million of filed 2025 amortization, equal to 37.1% of 2025 OE and 45.2% of anchor OE; actual OE adjustment unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: Adding back acquired-intangible amortization without deducting replacement investment increases historical and anchor OE, which increases all operating-value scenarios
audit_findings.evidence: The increase in amortization of intangible assets was driven by increased intangible assets related to recent business acquisitions.
audit_findings.explanation: The amortization charge and its acquisition origin are demonstrated, but the record does not establish whether the OE calculation added it back or imposed an offsetting maintenance charge. The exposed amount is large enough relative to both reported and anchor OE to change the valuation materially if the acquired customer relationships or technology require recurring replacement spending.
audit_findings.action: Produce the 2025 OE reconciliation showing treatment of the $37.169 million charge and identify any acquisition, product-development, customer-acquisition, or other replacement expenditure deducted; rerun with an economically supported maintenance charge if none was included.

audit_findings.title: Historical growth includes acquisition-funded expansion that the forecast may treat as free organic growth
audit_findings.magnitude: $360.770 million of filed acquisition cash outflows during 2023-2025, plus at least $159.228 million of disclosed equity consideration for Carbon6, SupplyPike, and Traverse Systems; OE and growth adjustment unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: Acquired earnings enter the historical OE trend and forecast growth while acquisition cash costs and issued shares may be omitted from reinvestment and dilution assumptions
audit_findings.evidence: The increase in recurring revenue customers is primarily due to recent acquisitions of 3P recurring revenue customers.
audit_findings.explanation: Acquisition-funded expansion is demonstrated, not merely prospective: the company spent substantial cash and shares on acquisitions, and the filing attributes much of the customer increase to them. The valuation has no perimeter adjustment and forecasts up to 6% growth without an identified acquisition or dilution cost. The June 2026 sale of the acquired 3P business for $8.768 million with a $23.454 million loss further confirms that historical acquired operations are not fully comparable with the forecast perimeter.
audit_findings.action: Build organic and acquired revenue, OE, and customer-growth bridges for 2023-2026; remove divested operations from the anchor; then rerun each scenario with either organic growth only or the recurring acquisition cash and share cost needed to support its growth rate.

audit_findings.title: An outstanding earn-out or deferred acquisition payment may be missing from the equity bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $24.656 million conservative ceiling from all June 2026 accounts payable, accrued expenses, and other non-current liabilities combined, equal to 1.86% of $1,328 million base equity value or $0.62 per diluted share; exact acquisition liability unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: An unpaid acquisition claim would be deducted in the equity bridge if it is not already reflected in future OE
audit_findings.evidence: Other adjustments for the year ended December 31, 2025 included the expense impacts from disposals of certain capitalized internally developed software, disposals of other equipment, remeasurement of acquired earn-out payments, and one-time acquisition-related insurance costs.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing confirms acquisition-related earn-out remeasurement but does not separately disclose the outstanding balance. Even treating every dollar in the plausible payable and accrued-liability captions as acquisition consideration gives a deliberately conservative effect of only $0.62 per share, leaving base value far below the $83 market price. The actual effect must be smaller because those captions also contain ordinary operating liabilities.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the June 30, 2026 contingent-consideration and deferred-purchase-payment rollforward and deduct the exact unpaid amount if it is not already represented in OE.

audit_findings.title: The non-operating-income purge may be incomplete
audit_findings.magnitude: Filed realized investment and cash-related foreign-currency gains were $0.388 million in 2025, $0.115 million in 2024, and $1.726 million in 2023; the $2.229 million three-year total equals 0.97% of corresponding OE
audit_findings.mechanism: Unpurged gains increase historical OE while the associated cash is also added through the equity bridge
audit_findings.evidence: Other income, net consists primarily of investment income, in addition to realized gain (loss) from investments held and realized gain (loss) from foreign currency impacts on cash and investments.
audit_findings.explanation: The calculation's treatment remains unverified, but the filed amounts available for 2023-2025 are small: the 2025 amount is only 0.39% of $100.1 million OE, and the three-year total is less than 1% of corresponding OE. Even assuming all disclosed amounts were retained, they are not large enough to change the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Trace each year's other-income adjustment through the OE workpaper, including realized investment and cash-related foreign-exchange effects; rerun only if the unpurged 2016-2022 aggregate proves materially larger than the disclosed recent amounts.
